newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shippers want KLM to justify prices.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shippers want KLM to justify prices.

text.p: Dutch shippers' organisation EVO has called for a detailed breakdown of the recent airfreight rate increase from KLM, claiming its members face extensive economic hardship following the price hike.

KLM Cargo, the airfreight wing of KLM, said recently it would be adding a fuel surcharge on shipments worldwide reflecting the steep rise in air kerosene prices. From November 1, the Dutch airline applied a worldwide increase of 20 guilder cents per kilo or the equivalent in local currency.
Hans Leijgraaf, secretary of the air shippers' board at EVO, said he has urgently requested a detailed breakdown of the price increase.

"Initially, I strongly demanded a postponement of the increase, but when this was not forthcoming, I have demanded an explanation of how KLM came to this specific increase,' he told Reuters in a telephone interview.

Many members of EVO, which represents some 36,500 Dutch transport companies, have voiced their protest at the size of the increase and Leijgraaf said KLM had indicated that it would be prepared to individually negotiate with hardship cases.
"The problem is every Dutch shipper is now a hardship case following this increase." he added.

KLM spokesman Peter Welheuner said the airline's rate increase "is in our opinion moderate and is related to the increased price of kerosine." He could not say how the airline's management would respond to EVO's demands. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
